title_as_printed: Drawing a line?—Visuo-constructive function as discriminator between healthy individuals, subjective cognitive decline, mild cognitive impairment and Alzheimer’s disease and predictor of disease progress compared to a multimodal approach

blind_codes.Sample_N: 622 (33 HC + 68 SCD + 301 MCI + 220 AD); 117 at follow-up

registry_codes.Sample_N_Approx: N= 622 (33 HC + 68 SCD + 301 MCI + 220 AD); follow-up n=117

Task_Type.reason: Discrimination is quantified (ROC AUC, sensitivity/specificity at Youden cut-points, kappa, percent correctly allocated), so T4 is excluded. Two readings are supported: T1, because the paper runs a binary MCI vs non-MCI (SCD+HC) ROC analysis (MMSE AUC 0.700, CDT 0.599, VVT 0.6); and T3, because it also fits four-group multinomial logistic regression over HC/SCD/MCI/AD (my blind code). The registry's T1 is one of the two.
Task_Type.quote: Analogous ROC analyses were calculated for the discrimination of MCI and non-MCI excluding AD patients and SCD and non-SCD excluding the groups AD and MCI from analysis.

Category.reason: Paper-and-pencil neuropsychological screening tests (MMSE, Sunderland CDT, VVT 3.0 Screening) in a memory-clinic cohort.

Validation_Type.reason: Cut-points and multinomial regressions are fitted and evaluated on the whole sample; no cross-validation or held-out partition is reported, so V2 under the absence-of-reporting rule.

Sample_N_Approx.reason: 622 analysed cross-sectionally (33 HC, 68 SCD, 301 MCI, 220 AD); 117 at follow-up.
Sample_N_Approx.quote: Data from 622 patients (33 HC, 68 SCD, 301 MCI, 220 AD) who completed all three tests were obtained.

Publication_Year.reason: Online-first 1 February 2023; issue Neuropsychiatr (2024) 38:71-81. Registry uses the issue year.

ADNI_Dependent.reason: Retrospective data from the Vienna Conversion to Dementia Study (Medical University of Vienna); no ADNI.

notes: Headline result is AD vs all others (VVT sensitivity 62.1%, specificity 83.1%); the MCI vs non-MCI discrimination is weak (AUC 0.60-0.70). A secondary ROC on 76 MCI patients predicts progression (MMSE AUC 0.808).
